falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 posts a daily close at least 2.5% above the highest close of the prior 20 sessions within 14 days, and the NYSE cumulative advance-decline line makes a new 20-day high on that same close.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Price and breadth are expanding through the stall, so the mini_top_2019_jun analog and the HOLD are wrong; the tape is a continuation, not an unresolved top.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes 6% or more below today's close within 14 days and the VIX closes above 30 on the same day.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The move is a real risk-off break, not a mini-top pause, so UNKNOWN/HOLD is invalidated; the correct call would have been risk-off.

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern-match similarity to mini_top_2019_jun falls below 40% for three consecutive sessions, or the blowoff score closes outside 40-70 (below 40 or at or above 75) for three consecutive sessions, within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The analog and blowoff reading that justify an unresolved HOLD no longer hold, so the UNKNOWN verdict is falsified either by a broken pattern or by a confirmed blowoff.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
